scope: Optional actual exportable-source-copy build, measured static Web editable project export, explicit frontend download. Not full game acceptance, release or fresh dependency installation certification.
implementation: Task editableProject:true requires game.develop, build/runtime-smoke, a static runtimeArtifact and explicit full artifact-directory write authority. Existing tasks/static export remain optional and unchanged.

Host enumerates actual source bytes, excludes old runtime artifact/private dot files/installed node_modules/saved Review reports and confirmed BGS workspace transcript/diagnostic paths. Other logs/ files remain game sources. Source-copy build omits these records too, rather than packaging an incomplete source set.

Existing bun run build driver runs in owned temporary source copy. Installed project-local dependencies are separately hashed and linked for build, require a saved lockfile and are not archived. Source sets/bytes and dependencies rechecked; successful canonical output replaces only authorized artifact directory, removing stale output files.

Only actual passed v3-editable-build.1 source provenance and same-artifact passed v3-static-artifact.1 runtime-smoke on current successful Attempt qualify project export. Old measurements do not gain source proof by download.

POST export kind:project returns project/ source/package/lock/data/assets plus the same artifact at its original relative path, and measurement.json outside project/. Every archive byte and current source/dependency/artifact set is checked before returning. No build/model/state mutation on download.

Whole-source provenance verification is local to editable build/export, not added as a full-project invalidation rule to unrelated tasks. Undeclared source drift refuses editable ZIP but unchanged measured static output keeps existing export qualification.

Existing project.read/project.export permission, ownership, writer/busy and Run revision checks retained. Frontend separate editable button needs source proof, verifies response package kind; errors never auto-rebuild, downgrade to static or dispatch.
Trusted Dashboard CORS exposes only artifact identity and package-kind headers. Existing origin whitelist/credential policy and Preview sandbox remain unchanged.
Uses optional CheckResult/Run JSON fields, existing local/DB persistence and ZIP32 writer. No new DB tables, frameworks, native tool modifications or execution-turn limits.

actualExecution.sourceProject: Synthetic Bun static project: actual source-copy build -> Chromium initial-load measurement -> ZIP extraction -> actual rebuild with identical directory SHA-256 -> source edit/rebuild with different SHA-256; extracted original and edited build both actual runtime-smoke observed.
actualExecution.dependency: Synthetic project-local library actually imported during build, with stored installed-directory hash and exported lockfile; no dependency installation or external network.
actualExecution.native: Real CLI loopback fake provider variant editable: native Write -> normal end -> original host executor source-copy build -> actual Chromium smoke -> source-provenance export. Exactly two fake-provider requests, no extra mechanical handoff/model request.
actualExecution.compatibility: Existing real CLI Review/Question/owner Repair/remeasure/follow-up and shared UI/Canvas consumption/Preview selection retained in full selected regression.
actualExecution.limits: Protocol and byte identity evidence, not real model quality, full gameplay, touch/audio/platform compatibility or fresh-install reproducibility.

failedExploration.finding: New real native editable variant found BGS workspace logs/index.json, logs/runtime-diagnostics.jsonl and transcripts/ were included in the initial source enumeration.
failedExploration.resolution: Read actual SessionManager/rotation implementation, exclude its reserved record paths while retaining other logs files, assert original three source paths; no relaxed expectation or original log rewrite.

server.note: Exact diagnostic lines match baseline; whole-server typecheck still fails.

limitations: deliveryEligible:false retained; static Web engineering export only, not native/server/XR package or full game acceptance.
No Claude Code native source edits or real generated project/evidence edits, paid provider call, deployment/restart or real database migration.
Source-copy build is not an OS/network sandbox. Installed dependency hashes/runtime identity are explicit build operands; fresh installation and bit-reproducible builds are not guaranteed.
ZIP remains memory-collected ZIP32 with source/dependency scanning cost; no big-project performance claim. Executable file metadata/empty-directory portability are not certified.
Real database competition/recovery and deployed full Dashboard browser download/interaction not exercised. Existing old BeeGameLivePreviewPage avatar/jsdom Path2D failures are not claimed fixed.

Initial planning/conversational change UI, formal source editing, other target consumption/whole-game coverage remain incomplete. Optional new task/check fields do not permit older executors to ignore source-copy build qualification.
